name: mcp_servers
description: Drive the MCP servers the user connected on the MCP Servers page (remote tools over OAuth). action=list returns every server with its name, status and tool count; action=tools returns one server's tools with their input JSON Schema; action=call runs one of those tools with an arguments JSON object string. Always list -> tools -> call, never invent a server or tool name. Only a connected server can be called; if it needs authorization, ask the user to press Authorize on the MCP Servers page.

action.description: list = all servers; tools = one server's tool list + schemas; call = run one tool.

server.description: Server name from action=list (or its id). Required for tools and call.

tool.description: Tool name from action=tools. Required for call.

arguments.description: JSON object string of the tool arguments that match its input_schema, e.g. {"query":"hello"}. Omit or use {} when the tool takes none.
